query_text: What is the replacement interval and part number for the high-pressure fuel filter on CFM56-7B engines?

ground_truth_anchors.section_breadcrumb: Chapter 70 Standard Practices > Powerplant General
ground_truth_anchors.canonical_span: Engine maintenance scheduling adheres to MSG-3 task intervals as outlined in the operator maintenance manual.

hard_negatives.canonical_span: Low-pressure fuel strainer part number 883441-B requires visual inspection every 4,000 flight hours.
